_comment: Budgets for scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs (KB = 1000 bytes), measured on the web build (pnpm --filter @openreel/web build). Set a few percent above the measured size so an accidental import that drags a registry or engine into the startup path fails CI, while normal feature growth in lazy chunks does not.

entry.note: startup entry chunk: (1.0 release: 180 -> 182 for ACES project settings and .prproj import wiring; CI Linux measured 180.5)  everything the first paint compiles and evaluates. w9: video/motion/audio engines, action handlers, export engine and schema normalizers are behind services/lazy-engines (1988 KB / 568.8 KB gzip before; 608.5 / 179.0 after). Entry diet: the desktop-only native ffmpeg backend, native decode, path hydration and smart-render load lazily inside main.tsx's isDesktop branch, and the in-thread RAW developer (dng, develop, tiff, color) loads on first use (621.0 / 190.0 before; 577.3 / 174.7 after)

editor.note: lazy editor chunk (background warm-up on desktop)

agent.note: lazy agent/MCP executor chunk, must stay lazy (w9: +25 KB for FCPXML compound clips and multicam interchange, frame-scale tool)
